fields.statement: At fb839bf1, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/plan-run-milestone-env passes: the daemon starts plan runs for a request queued with --milestone ms and one without; run start --request for the first launches a fake claude whose env file holds exactly RHIZA_MILESTONE=<ms intent ID>, and for the second the file is empty even though the outer env sets RHIZA_MILESTONE= (launchEnv unsets it). The diff carries the request's Milestone through requestRun into the run's started entry (run.Started/State.Milestone), and StartAgent reads it into the session record, which launchEnv sets or unsets. The request/plan testscripts, internal/api (with the updated unset lists in session_test.go), internal/run and internal/session also pass.
